title: Text-to-music generation models capture musical semantic representations in the human brain
core_idea: Investigate whether high-level semantic information encoded by text-to-music generation models corresponds to human brain activity by using fMRI, encoding-model analyses, and by predicting music-model embeddings from brain data to reconstruct or generate music via a music language model.
tldr: Use fMRI to probe the correspondence between semantic embeddings from text-to-music models and auditory-cortex activity, and explore the feasibility of generating music by predicting those embeddings from brain scans.
